title: Success of Foreign Worker Ambassador Programme in Increasing Well-being of Foreign Workers
what_it_is: Success of Foreign Worker Ambassador Programme in Increasing Well-being of Foreign Workers

sections.label: Foreign Worker Ambassadors pool growth
sections.summary: MOM, with the Migrant Workers' Centre, grew the pool of Foreign Worker Ambassadors from about 300 in November 2014 to 2,600 in September 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To date, in partnership with the Migrant Workers' Centre (MWC), MOM has grown this pool of Foreign Worker Ambassadors from about 300 in November 2014 to 2,600 in September 2018.

sections.label: Saiful briefs construction workers
sections.summary: Mr Molla Mohammad Saifullah, or Saiful, conducts briefing sessions on employment rights and regulations for construction workers, and more than 1,000 foreign workers have benefited.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: (a) Mr Molla Mohammad Saifullah, or Saiful, conducts briefing sessions on employment rights and regulations for construction workers like himself.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We understand that more than 1,000 foreign workers have benefited from his efforts so far.

sections.label: Raj advises on salary issues
sections.summary: Mr Veluchamy Muniapparaj, or Raj, voluntarily advises fellow foreign workers on salary issues and has helped at least two recover salaries through MOM.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: (c) Mr Veluchamy Muniapparaj, or Raj, voluntarily provides advice on salary issues to fellow foreign workers, having gone through a wage dispute before.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: He has helped at least two of them seek assistance from MOM and recover their salaries successfully.

sections.label: MOM to grow Ambassador pool
sections.summary: MOM will continue working with MWC to grow the pool of Foreign Worker Ambassadors to strengthen peer support networks amongst foreign workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM will continue to work with MWC to grow this pool of Foreign Worker Ambassadors to strengthen peer support networks amongst our foreign workers.
